title: File:Bulgarian frigate Verni (42) in the Black Sea in July 2015.JPG
art: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Luis R. Chavez
desc:
The Bulgarian Navy frigate Verni (42) approaches the U.S. Navy guided-missile destroyer USS Porter (DDG-78), not visible, during a towing simulation in the Black Sea as part of Exercise Breeze 2015.
Verni is the former Belgian frigate Wielingen (F910) that was sold to Bulgaria in 2009.
